notes: Fix LAN NAT hairpin (loopback) traffic timing out end-to-end even though the v0.4.64 DNAT/masquerade rules were correct: mark_egress was policy-routing both the forward and reply legs out the wrong WAN egress table before DNAT/un-NAT ever ran. Confirmed live with a real RustDesk port-forward test via DDNS from a LAN client.
